doc.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Set lists
summary: Rendón keeps a set list in the book.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Wow. Well I have to get you to your next assignment. But it’s really fascinating talking to you and I’m looking forward to your band tonight. Do you write out a set list beforehand of course?
Oh yes, yes, yes, I have a set list which, it’s in the book. The book’s right in order, everything’s all set.
